description: Recent records from a common Los Angeles open dataset (data.lacity.org) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime in Los Angeles / LA", "LAPD arrests", "LA building permits", "MyLA311 requests", "active businesses in LA". Names: crime, arrests, businesses, permits, 311. Returns the latest rows (newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use la_query. (Note: LA 311 is partitioned by year — the shortcut points at the latest year; use la_datasets for other years.)

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

dataset.description: One of: crime, arrests, businesses, permits, 311.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter, e.g. "crm_cd_desc='BURGLARY'" or "area_name='Hollywood'". Omit for all recent rows.

name: la_recent
title: La Recent
